scope: Friend's exact implementation unavailable. New controlled comparison; numbers should not be treated as replication.
logit_loss: 0.5*(student_logit-clipped_teacher_logit)^2 / max(var(fitting_teacher_logit),1); mixed uses alpha=0.5. Clip teacher score to [1e-6,1-1e-6] before inverse sigmoid.
compact_selection: Train-only chi2 rank of original TF-IDF; refit TF-IDF / L2 on selected vocabulary.
validation_threshold: 1% benign FPR on fixed export-seed OOF; evaluated as frozen on Validation. Quantized evaluated at same threshold.
evaluation: Previous development folds reused, 24 positives in supplementary Validation, no Official Test/external.
